chunks: They wished to entrap him, but We made them the greatest losers.
ai.seo_question: How did God turn the enemies' plot against them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) or specifically Imam Ali (AS), illustrating how divine protection transforms the cunning of the elite into their own ruin. It underscores the concept of *Tawfiq* (divine success) where God’s will supersedes human strategy, serving as a comfort to the faithful against political and social conspiracies. The 'losers' (*al-akhsarin*) refers not just to material loss but to the spiritual deficit of those who oppose divine truth.
